title: Ya-Sin revision: what we know and how to keep it: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Tajweed mastery and Al-Kahf consolidation
source: Written for quran/y11 lesson 10 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin revision rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 10. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: يسٓ (١) وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ (٢) إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ (٣) عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ (٤) تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ (٥) لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ (٦)

panels.title: Two groups, one class
points: Readers: from the mushaf, partner checks

questions.q: Recite or read 36:9 and name the iqlab and the izhar.
questions.a: مِنۢ بَيْنِ: iqlab; وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ: izhar.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: recite or read 36:1 to 12 to a partner who marks the rubric (pupil PDF). Today's rota group recites to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner rubric and target; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: set your Ya-Sin target for this term in the portal log.
questions.a: Realistic target (revise all, or memorise a set portion).

questions.q: «يسٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ»: the noon of seen in Hafs is ...
questions.a: A) Clear (izhar). A Hafs detail: izhar, as also in نٓ وَٱلْقَلَمِ.

questions.q: Think again: Some of you know Ya-Sin by heart; some are reading it carefully. How can both groups help each other today?
questions.a: Reciters model fluency; readers follow the mushaf and check accuracy: both learn.
